title: BIR Form No. 2553 - Return of Percentage Tax Payable Under Special Laws

choice_rows.label: Item 13 — Availing of tax relief under a Special Law or International Tax Treaty?
If overpayment, mark one:
options: To be issued a Tax Credit Certificate

validation.how: Messages render only in the bottom 'Needs review' panel, first 20 only; a field label turns red only for parse errors and the Email field.

findings.now: Clicking Fiscal while the year-end is December silently switches the month to Jun, with no alert or message.
findings.why: The official alert 'You have entered a filing year ending in December. This filing will be considered as a Calendar Year Filing.' (rule 2553-input-019) is never raised, so the filed period changes without notice.

options.name: Show the official alert
options.detail: Keep December and raise the verbatim input-019 text in Needs review, as the official page does.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: Open Fiscal with no preset month and require a Jan to Nov pick from a combobox.

options.name: Read-only chip
options.detail: Show the year-end as a read-only chip that changes only through an explicit Change action.

findings.now: An invalid Taxpayer Name keeps a normal-coloured label; the red message appears only in the Needs review panel at the bottom.
findings.why: The label check compares editor keys such as name with validation keys such as taxpayer_name, so only the Email field ever matches.

options.name: Map error keys
options.detail: Translate each validation field name to its editor key before the label colour check.

options.name: Inline message
options.detail: Render the matching message directly under the field so the error sits next to the input.

findings.now: The button is greyed out while any error exists, and nothing beside it says why; the reason sits in Needs review far below.
findings.why: The button is disabled whenever validation_errors is non-empty, so the status line that explains the block can never show.

options.name: Status line
options.detail: Show 'N items need review' beside the toolbar buttons while errors exist.

options.name: Enabled button
options.detail: Keep the button enabled and scroll to Needs review when it is clicked.

findings.now: Twelve month chips wrap across the row; under the default Calendar basis all twelve are greyed out, and in Fiscal mode Dec is greyed out.
findings.why: Twelve options is well past the four-option limit for buttons, and the disabled chips hide which months can actually be picked.

options.name: Combobox
options.detail: Use one combobox that lists only the valid months and appears only when Fiscal is chosen.

options.name: Read-only chip
options.detail: Show Dec as a read-only chip under Calendar and open the combobox only after Fiscal is chosen.

findings.field: 20A — Tax paid in return previously filed (amended only)
findings.now: After Item 4 is switched to No, the greyed 20A box keeps its old amount while 20C and the saved return exclude it.
findings.why: edit() recomputes and zeroes tax_paid_previous but never reloads the input text, so the screen and the draft disagree.

options.name: Reset the box
options.detail: Reload the 20A editor to blank whenever Item 4 changes to No, as clear_atc already does for ATC rows.

options.name: Read-only chip
options.detail: Show 20A as a computed read-only amount that appears only when Item 4 is Yes.

findings.now: Four outlined chips sit under the schedule, and codes already used stay visible but greyed out.
findings.why: ATC is multi-select with five official slots, so a multi-select combobox fits better than per-option chips.

options.name: Multi-select combobox
options.detail: One combobox that adds a row per pick and hides codes that are already used.

options.name: Chips without taken options
options.detail: Keep the chips but remove taken options instead of greying them out.

findings.now: Removing a middle ATC leaves an empty 'Item 15 — ' card whose tax rate reads '?%'.
findings.why: clear_atc blanks the row in place (crates/bir-core/src/forms/form_2553.rs:309-317) and the row renderer has no fallback for a blank ATC.

options.name: Compact rows
options.detail: Shift later rows up when one is removed so no gap appears.

options.name: Hide blank rows
options.detail: Render only filled rows and place the next pick in the first gap.

findings.now: A typed amount such as 1234.567 stays as typed, while the computed amounts use the rounded 1,234.57.
findings.why: Only the Change event is subscribed, so nothing rewrites the box with formatCurrency output on blur as the official page does.

options.name: Reformat on blur
options.detail: On blur, write official_amount of the value back into the box.

options.name: Two-decimal limit
options.detail: Refuse a third decimal digit while typing.

findings.now: Only the first 20 messages appear, and any further errors are dropped with no count.
findings.why: The take(20) cap truncates the list silently.

options.name: Show all
options.detail: Remove the cap and let the panel scroll.

options.name: Overflow line
options.detail: Keep 20 rows and add an 'and N more' line.

findings.now: A new return opens with a quarter already chosen from today's date, which is Q4 for any year other than the current one.
findings.why: new_draft ignores the library tile's period argument (_period), so the quarter comes from the clock rather than from the user or the tile.

options.name: Unselected quarter
options.detail: Open with no quarter chosen so the official 'Select a Quarter on Item no. 3.' alert guards queueing.

options.name: Tile period
options.detail: Use the library tile's period when one is supplied and leave the quarter blank only when it is not.
